body: Sri Lankan lawmaker Namal Rajapaksa faces 24 charges relating to an alleged bribe of 100 million rupees, about $300,000, connected with SriLankan Airlines' purchase of Airbus aircraft. Prosecutors told a Colombo court that formal charges had been filed in the High Court, and the indictment also names Shamindra Rajapaksa, Priyanka Niyomalie and Biz Solutions (Pvt) Ltd. Rajapaksa, the son of former President Mahinda Rajapaksa, denies wrongdoing. He was arrested on September 4, 2026, after questioning by Sri Lanka's Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption, appeared before a three-judge High Court bench on October 28, 2026, and was ordered to return on November 19 while remaining in custody, according to local news outlets cited in the report.

The allegations relate to the national carrier's 2013 order for six Airbus A330-300s and four A350-900s; the A350s were never delivered. Investigators allege funds linked to the transaction moved through overseas companies and bank accounts before reaching Rajapaksa. Specifically, an alleged $800,000 transfer went from a Singapore account held by Biz Solutions to Sabre Vision Holdings, a company owned by a Sri Lankan businessman, who investigators charge then paid 100 million rupees in bribes in 2014 and 2015. In 2021, SriLankan Airlines sought $1 billion from Airbus for damages, reputational harm and other costs, demanded cancellation of its four-A350-900 agreement, and sought return of $19 million in advance payments. This followed the wider Airbus corruption investigation, in which Airbus agreed in January 2020 to pay more than $3.9 billion to resolve bribery and export-control cases with authorities in the US, France and the United Kingdom; the British case covered payments involving Sri Lanka and four other countries. Former SriLankan Airlines CEO Kapila Chandrasena, who had faced charges connected with the aircraft purchase, was found dead in Colombo in May 2026.
en.summary: Namal Rajapaksa faces 24 charges over an alleged 100-million-rupee bribe linked to SriLankan Airlines' purchase of Airbus aircraft; he denies wrongdoing and, after appearing in court on October 28, must return on November 19 while remaining in custody.
en.title: Sri Lankan lawmaker faces 24 charges in Airbus bribery case

facts.claim: 納馬爾·拉賈帕克薩面臨24項指控，涉嫌收受1億盧比賄款，案件與斯里蘭卡航空採購空中巴士客機有關。
檢方已向可倫坡高等法院正式提出指控；拉賈帕克薩是前總統馬欣達·拉賈帕克薩之子，否認不法。
拉賈帕克薩2026年9月4日在反賄賂委員會問話後被捕，10月28日出庭三人高等法院合議庭，須於11月19日再度出庭，目前仍遭羈押。
起訴書亦點名沙明德拉·拉賈帕克薩、普里揚卡·尼約馬利與涉案的私人有限公司。
案件涉及斯里蘭卡航空2013年訂購6架A330-300與4架A350-900，其中A350-900從未交付。
調查人員指稱資金經海外公司與帳戶流轉，一筆80萬美元款項由涉案公司的新加坡帳戶轉至一名斯里蘭卡商人擁有的公司，該商人隨後於2014年與2015年支付1億盧比賄款。
斯里蘭卡航空2021年向空中巴士求償10億美元，要求取消4架A350-900合約並退還1900萬美元預付款。
空中巴士2020年1月同意支付逾39億美元，與美國、法國與英國當局和解賄賂與出口管制案件，英國案件涉及斯里蘭卡等5國付款。
前斯里蘭卡航空執行長卡皮拉·錢德拉塞納曾因購機案面臨指控，2026年5月在可倫坡被發現身亡。
